description.describe_ch: 本課程透過深入閱讀分析國際財經英文新聞，建立財經基礎知識，包括財務、金融、永續金融及公司治理等。亦強調培養學生的英文聽力、閱讀和溝通表達技巧，確保學生掌握專業術語，理解財經議題背景和未來趨勢，以應對未來職場挑戰。
description.describe_eh: This course aims to establish a foundational knowledge of finance, including accounting, financial markets, sustainable finance, and corporate governance, through in-depth reading and analysis of international financial news in English. It also focuses on improving students' English listening, reading, and communication skills, ensuring they master professional terminology and understand financial topics' background and future trends to meet workplace challenges.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂規則
1. Be on time. 請準時上課。
2. Participate in the class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。
3. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration.學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。
4. Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. 請購買正版課本，請勿使用複製版本。
5. The texts and exercises will be completed in class. Please bring textbooks to class. 請上課攜帶課本，以利上課活動使用。
6. Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the exam date. Relevant documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late application will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor. 若須要補考的同學，請遵照學校的補考規定，在考試後的3天內提出申請。若考試當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。
7. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee. 考試請遵照考場規定，若作弊者以0分計算。

綜合說明
  1. Students must exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in their academic activities, avoiding plagiarism and falsification of data.學生在學術活動中必須展現誠實和道德行為，避免抄襲和篡改資料。
  2. Plagiarism: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism.抄襲：必須適當引用來源。未經適當標示使用他人作品屬於抄襲行為。
  3. Cheating: Following exam rules is mandatory. Unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating.考試作弊：必須遵守考試規則，禁止使用未經授權的材料或與他人串通作弊。
